support.description: We're here to help you with all your queries.

items.question: What is AduCrest University?
items.answer: AduCrest University is an educational institution dedicated to providing quality learning, skilled faculty and a supportive environment to help students achieve their academic and career goals.

items.question: Is online learning available?
items.answer: Selected programmes include online learning resources and flexible study activities. Contact our admissions team to confirm the delivery format and availability for your chosen course.

items.question: Can I access classes anytime?
items.answer: Recorded resources can be accessed at your own pace when they are included in your programme. Live classes and on-campus sessions follow a published timetable.

items.question: Do you provide study materials?
items.answer: Course learning materials, recommended reading and assignments are shared by your faculty. The exact resources depend on your programme and are explained at the start of each module.

items.question: Do you offer student support?
items.answer: Yes. Students can seek academic guidance, course advice and help with university services from faculty and the student support team. Use our contact page to reach the appropriate team.

items.question: Can I reset my password?
items.answer: For an existing student account, contact the university's support team for help with account recovery. This public website does not include a student login or password-reset service.

courses.title: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.)

image.alt: Arts & Humanities student at AduCrest University

mainImage.alt: A university classroom for the Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) programme

overview: Explore literature, history, culture and the ideas that shape our world. Our Bachelor of Arts combines a broad academic foundation with opportunities to develop your interests through elective study.

Seminars, research projects and community activities connect your learning with the world beyond the classroom. Learn to evaluate evidence, communicate clearly and understand society from different perspectives.
outcomes: Connect the humanities with contemporary issues

courses.title: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.)

image.alt: Science student at AduCrest University

mainImage.alt: A university classroom for the Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) programme

overview: Build a rigorous understanding of scientific principles through our Bachelor of Science. Study the natural world with a balanced programme of theory, laboratory practice and analytical investigation.
Choose specialist modules across physics, chemistry and biology, then apply your knowledge to guided experiments and a final research project. Academic mentors support your next steps.
outcomes: Apply the scientific method to real questions

courses.title: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.)

image.alt: Commerce student at AduCrest University

mainImage.alt: A university classroom for the Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) programme

overview: Develop a strong foundation in accounting, economics and business through our Bachelor of Commerce. The programme connects commercial theory with the practical decisions made by modern organisations.
Case studies, financial analysis and collaborative assignments build your understanding of how enterprises work. Learn to read financial information and communicate professional recommendations.
outcomes: Apply the principles of business law

courses.title: Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.)

image.alt: Engineering student at AduCrest University

mainImage.alt: A university classroom for the Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) programme

overview: Turn curiosity into practical solutions with our Bachelor of Technology. This programme combines engineering fundamentals, mathematics and hands-on design to prepare you for a changing technical world.
Work in project teams, develop prototypes and explore contemporary engineering tools. Design challenges encourage thoughtful problem solving, responsible innovation and clear technical communication.

courses.title: Master of Business Administration (MBA)

image.alt: Management student at AduCrest University

mainImage.alt: A university classroom for the Master of Business Administration (MBA) programme

previewImage.alt: Master of Business Administration (MBA) course preview

overview: This comprehensive Business Management programme provides essential knowledge and practical skills for today's dynamic business world. Learn how strategic planning, leadership and operations contribute to organisational success.
Develop your management skills through real-world examples, case studies and guided projects. The programme offers a structured learning path in finance, marketing, people management and strategy.
outcomes: Learn strategic planning and decision making
Improve problem solving and critical thinking
Prepare for career growth in business

courses.title: Master of Computer Applications (MCA)

image.alt: Computer Applications student at AduCrest University

mainImage.alt: A university classroom for the Master of Computer Applications (MCA) programme

previewImage.alt: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) course preview

overview: Build reliable software and deepen your understanding of modern computing with our Master of Computer Applications. Study software engineering, databases, networks and application development through a practical curriculum.
From requirements to deployment, work through the full software development process. Team projects and a final application connect computer science principles with the needs of real users.
outcomes: Build and document a complete application

courses.title: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm)

image.alt: Medical & Health Sciences student at AduCrest University

mainImage.alt: A university classroom for the Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) programme

overview: Explore the science behind medicines and their responsible use with our Bachelor of Pharmacy. The programme introduces pharmaceutical chemistry, pharmacology and safe, ethical professional practice.
Laboratory learning and case-based discussion connect theory with pharmacy practice. Develop careful analytical habits and an understanding of quality standards.
outcomes: Follow laboratory safety and quality procedures

courses.title: Bachelor of Design (B.Des)

image.alt: Design student at AduCrest University

mainImage.alt: A university classroom for the Bachelor of Design (B.Des) programme

overview: Bring ideas to life through our Bachelor of Design. Explore visual communication, design thinking and creative practice while learning how design responds to people's needs.
Studio projects encourage experimentation, critique and collaboration. Build a portfolio that demonstrates your process, from research and concept sketches to refined design outcomes.

courses.title: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)

image.alt: Management student at AduCrest University

mainImage.alt: A university classroom for the Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) programme

previewImage.alt: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) course preview

overview: Discover how businesses plan, organise and grow with our Bachelor of Business Administration. Build a broad foundation in management, marketing, finance and entrepreneurship.
Practical assignments help you connect concepts with everyday business challenges. Develop the confidence to contribute to teams and evaluate opportunities.

courses.title: Master of Arts (M.A.)

image.alt: Arts & Humanities student at AduCrest University

mainImage.alt: A university classroom for the Master of Arts (M.A.) programme

overview: Deepen your understanding of literature, culture and critical thought through our Master of Arts. Advanced seminars give you space to investigate ideas and develop your own academic perspective.
Work closely with faculty on independent research, thoughtful discussion and sustained writing. A dissertation lets you explore a focused question using appropriate research methods.

courses.title: Master of Science (M.Sc.)

image.alt: Science student at AduCrest University

mainImage.alt: A university classroom for the Master of Science (M.Sc.) programme

overview: Strengthen your scientific expertise through advanced study and research in our Master of Science. Develop specialist knowledge alongside rigorous experimental and analytical skills.
Advanced laboratory work, seminars and a supervised project support your growth as an independent investigator. Learn to evaluate findings and explain their significance responsibly.

courses.title: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)

image.alt: Computer Applications student at AduCrest University

mainImage.alt: A university classroom for the Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) programme

previewImage.alt: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) course preview

overview: Begin your journey in computing with our Bachelor of Computer Applications. Learn programming, databases and web technologies while developing a foundation in computer systems.
Guided practical work helps you turn concepts into useful applications. Build confidence through individual assignments, collaborative projects and explaining your technical decisions.
